occupant.name: agent_orientation_read
occupant.description: Receive the bounded Carrier-entry orientation. Call with {} first, then replay only the exact opaque continuation returned in next_call until status=ready. The Carrier retains receipts, hashes, page coordinates, and completion evidence.

continuation.description: Opaque continuation returned by the preceding next_call. Do not inspect or alter it.

occupant.name: mcp_output_show
occupant.description: Read a materialized Agent Context MCP output ref with offset/limit paging.

admin.name: agent_orientation_read
admin.description: Receive the exact Carrier-entry Orientation Brief and its next_call. Call with no arguments first, then follow next_call exactly; required-read pages persist server-owned completion evidence and selections inspect exact entry snapshots.

step_id.description: Optional exact pending step_id returned by required_read_progress or next_call.

offset.description: Exact UTF-8 byte offset returned by the preceding next_call. Use 0 for the first page.

selection.description: Inspect the exact continuity or work artifact selected by this admitted manifest.

admin.name: agent_orientation_acknowledge
admin.description: Open the orientation gate after Agent Context has recorded every exact required read. No hashes, timestamps, or evidence payloads are accepted from the occupant.

admin.name: agent_context_guidance
admin.description: Show model-facing operating guidance for agent-context MCP workflows.

workflow.description: Optional workflow name or area to focus guidance on.

tool.description: Optional tool name for tool-specific guidance.

admin.name: agent_context_doctor
admin.description: Check site-local agent-context DB readiness and schema presence.

admin.name: agent_context_whoami
admin.description: Resolve the exact admitted Agent/Carrier Session binding from an owner-issued admission receipt. Historical recency is never identity evidence.

admin.name: agent_context_start_session
admin.description: Compile and retain an Orientation Manifest against an exact owner-issued Carrier Session admission receipt; the start event is only a downstream trace.

admin.name: agent_context_checkpoint
admin.description: Write a durable site-local agent checkpoint, optionally carrying canonical continuation state and linking an exact portable continuation artifact.

admin.name: agent_context_rehydrate
admin.description: Retrieve the latest site-local checkpoint, an exact current or archived checkpoint, or bounded checkpoint history for an agent.

checkpoint_id.description: Optional exact checkpoint ID. Searches current and archived checkpoints scoped to this agent.

admin.name: agent_context_continuation_export
admin.description: Render the latest canonical continuation as a bounded Site-local Markdown projection and attach its verified reference.

path.description: Optional Site-relative path under .ai/continuations ending in .md.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing projection at the explicit path.

admin.name: agent_context_continuation_read
admin.description: Read the latest or explicitly selected continuation and verify its portable Markdown projection against the checkpoint reference and canonical content hash.

checkpoint_id.description: Optional exact checkpoint ID. Searches current and archived checkpoints scoped to this agent.

admin.name: agent_context_hydrate_current
admin.description: Compile a read-only diagnostic Orientation Manifest candidate for the exact admitted Carrier Session, optionally including one explicitly selected checkpoint. It does not replace the admitted generation.

checkpoint_id.description: Optional exact checkpoint ID. Omission means continuity is omitted, never latest.

admin.name: agent_context_startup_sequence
admin.description: Read and deliver the exact immutable Orientation Manifest generation selected by the Carrier entry procedure. It never recompiles, selects latest, or mutates a checkpoint.

manifest_id.description: Optional exact manifest ID; must match NARADA_ORIENTATION_MANIFEST_ID when both are present.

admin.name: mcp_output_show
admin.description: Read a materialized Agent Context MCP output ref with offset/limit paging.
